sections.heading: Ingredients
items: 1 lb. beef tenderloin (cut into serving pieces)
Tenderize meat with a cleaver. Pour 1/2 cup of vegetable oil over the meat and vegetables. Let this set at room temperature for 30 min.
Add 1 TBS wine and 1 tsp ground ginger juice. Sprinkle with salt & pepper, drain off the oil and arrange on serving platter.
Heat a small amount of oil in large cast iron pan or electric skillet. When hot fry 1/3 meat & vegetables keeping each seperate. Cook quickly on medium heat until each is done.

sections.heading: Ingredients
items: 1/2 lb roast beef cut into thin slices
Marinate the meat in the marinating mixture for 30 minutes.
Place the potato cubes in the center of a steamer plate and pour extra juice over the potato.
Powder each peice of meat with the rice powder (both sides). Place the meat over the top of the potato and try to cover all of the potato with the meat.
Place the plate in a steamer and steam for at least an hour, with cover on. The longer you steam the more tender the meat. Serve hot.

sections.heading: PS
items: Pork or chicken may be substituted for the roast beef using the same procedures.

sections.heading: Ingredients
items: 2 LB thinly sliced good quality beef
Remove the beef from the freezer and let stand at room temperature. When it has partially defrosted, cut it with a lunch meat slicer or knife into very thin slices.

Using a hot iron pan, heat 2 TBS oil and stir fry the leek and onion until they are light brown and the flavor comes out. Add 1/4 cup of the sauce mixture. Add the bean curd, mushroom, bamboo shoot, noodle, and cabbage and cook until soft. Add the meat and spinach.
To serve, dip the cooked meat and/or vegetables in a bowl containing a mixture of raw egg, sugar and soy sauce.

sections.heading: Ingredients
items: 1 lb. beef tenderloin (cut into serving pieces)
Tenderize meat with a cleaver. Pour 1/2 cup of vegetable oil over the meat and vegetables. Let this set at room temperature for 30 min.
Add 1 TBS wine and 1 tsp ground ginger juice. Sprinkle with salt & pepper, drain off the oil and arrange on serving platter.
Heat a small amount of oil in large cast iron pan or electric skillet. When hot fry 1/3 meat & vegetables keeping each seperate. Cook quickly on medium heat until each is done.
Marinate the steak for 30 minutes. Deep fry the meat in hot oil and remove from the heat as soon as the color changes.
Using 3 TBS oil, stir fry the onion, tomato, and green pepper in the wok. Add the gravy sauce and the hot water and bring the mixture to a boil. Thicken the mixture with the cornstarch mixture.
Add the meat, heat momentarily, and then serve on a platter with rice.

sections.heading: Ingredients
items: 3 slices fresh ginger in thin strips
Slice the beef across the grain into very thin strips. Marinate the beef in the sauce for at least 1/2 hour.
Heat 1 cup of oil in the wok until very hot. Quick stir-fry the beef for about 15 seconds, drain it, and set aside.

Heat another 2 TBS oil in the wok until very hot. Stir-fry the scallion and ginger; then add the pepper and onion. Now add the beef, salt, sugar and sesame seed oil. Mix well and serve hot. If desired, you may add a small amount of hot chili paste.

sections.heading: Suggested seasoning amounts to be used with each serving
items: 1/2 TBS sugar water (4 TBS sugar in 1 cup of water)
Slice the meat across the grain and arrange each type of meat on separate platters. Do likewise with each type of vegetable.
Put each type of seasoning in separate containers which are clearly marked as to type of contents and suggested serving amount.

Each person prepares his own bowl to taste, taking vegetables first, then meats, and lastly the seasonings. On a special barbecue grill that is hot pour the mixture all over the grill, saving some of the juice. Using long chopsticks to move the mixture around, allow to cook for 1-2 minutes, place back in the serving bowl and serve hot.
Cut the flank steak across the grain into wide strips about 1 1/2 inches and skewer the strips of steak on bamboo stick (about 6-7 inch).
Marinate the steak in the sauce mixture overnight or more than 4 hours.
Cook over a hot charcoal fire until cooked.

sections.heading: Note
items: This recipe should only be used as a guide for you as it is important to see Jeanne prepare because of the unique style and skill involved.
Use 2 TB oil to stir-fry the meat until nice and brown. Add 1 TB hot bean sauce, scallion, ginger, and soy sauce. Bring to a boil and let cook for 1/2 minute. Remove to a saucepan.

Add the sauce ingredients and bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer for 1 1/2 hours covered. When the meat is tender, add the radish and cook for 1/2 hour more. Thicken with cornstarch mixture and serve.

Cut the meat into thin slices and marinate in sauce A for 15 minutes.
Heat wok and add 2 TB oil. Stir fry vegetables for short time. Remove and set aside.
Heat 2 TB oil and stir-fry the curry powder til flavor comes out. Then add the meat and stir-fry til well blended. Remove and set aside.
Bring sauce B to a boil. Add the vegetables and the meat. Stir til heated through and serve.
